text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...What? Why you starin' at me like that?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lemme guess, you're holdin' back from

commenting on how small I am.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I couldn't care less, not one
bit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Size isn't just 'bout stature—it's about
attitude. If
ya set your mind to being
big, you can be as big
as ya want!
